title: Rendition
description: A generated image, video or audio piece. Attributed to a READING, never to the text. See docs/04-generative.md.

rule.description: Which rule applied. Refusals are explained and appealable — a silent block on a religious request reads as contempt.

visibility.description: Inherits from the source annotation. Generating from a private note does not publish it.

provenance_embedded.description: C2PA or equivalent. Devotional imagery detaches from its source and travels; it must stay identifiable as generated after being screenshotted.

then.$comment: Synthetic recitation is not generated for any corpus; recitation is licensed from named human reciters.
